listing.description_html:
Every page is a dino adventure AND a fun fact!

Most dinosaur coloring books just give kids pictures. This one teaches them too. Each of the 40 pages has a big, friendly dinosaur to color, the dinosaur's name with an easy say it guide (try SER uh tops!), and an amazing fact kids love to repeat at the dinner table.

  • 40 original illustrations, each one different: T. rex, Triceratops, Spinosaurus, baby dinos, fossils and more
  • A fun fact on every page, written for curious kids ages 4 to 8
  • Say it guides for tricky dino names, so kids can show off what they learned
  • Big, bold lines and single sided pages, so markers never ruin the next picture
  • Free bonus pages: scan the code inside to print more at home

Perfect for birthdays, road trips and screen free afternoons. Add it to your cart today!

hooks: Roar! Watch him come to life
What color is your T rex?

01.label: T. rex
01.say: tie RAN oh SORE us rex
01.fact: T. rex had teeth as big as bananas, and it could chomp harder than any land animal alive today.

02.label: Dino Eggs
02.fact: All dinosaurs hatched from eggs, just like birds and turtles do today.

03.label: Triceratops
03.fact: Its name means three horned face. It munched on plants all day long.

04.label: Stegosaurus
04.fact: Stegosaurus was as long as a bus, but its brain was only about the size of a lime!

05.label: Brachiosaurus
05.fact: It was as tall as a four story building and ate leaves from the very tops of trees.

06.label: Pterodactyl
06.fact: Pterodactyls could fly, but they were flying reptiles, not dinosaurs!

07.label: Dino World
07.fact: Dinosaurs lived on Earth for about 165 million years. That is a really long time!

08.label: Dino Families
08.fact: Some dinosaurs, like Maiasaura, built nests and took care of their babies.

09.label: Ankylosaurus
09.fact: It had a heavy bony club at the end of its tail to keep it safe.

10.label: T. rex
10.say: tie RAN oh SORE us rex
10.fact: T. rex had very short arms with only two fingers on each hand.

11.label: Fossils
11.fact: Scientists learn about dinosaurs from fossils: bones that slowly turned into stone.

12.label: Long Ago
12.fact: The last dinosaurs lived more than 66 million years ago.

13.label: Spinosaurus
13.fact: Spinosaurus had a big sail on its back and loved to catch fish.

14.label: Velociraptor
14.fact: Velociraptor was only about as big as a turkey, and it had feathers!

15.label: Parasaurolophus
15.say: PAR ah sore OL oh fus
15.fact: Its long head crest may have worked like a trumpet to make loud sounds.

16.label: Herbivores
16.fact: Dinosaurs that ate only plants are called herbivores.

17.label: Dino Eggs
17.fact: Some dinosaur eggs were as big as a football!

18.label: Dino Cousins
18.fact: Birds are related to dinosaurs. A chicken is a distant cousin of T. rex!

19.label: Paleontologist
19.say: PAY lee on TOL oh jist
19.fact: A scientist who digs up and studies dinosaur fossils is called a paleontologist.

20.label: Carnivores
20.fact: Dinosaurs that ate meat are called carnivores.

21.label: Dinosaur
21.fact: The word dinosaur means terrible lizard.

22.label: Plesiosaurus
22.fact: It swam in the ocean with four big flippers. It was a sea reptile, not a dinosaur.

23.label: T. rex
23.say: tie RAN oh SORE us rex
23.fact: T. rex was about as long as a school bus!

24.label: Sleepy Dinos
24.fact: Some small dinosaurs slept curled up with their heads tucked in, just like birds.

25.label: Never Met
25.fact: Stegosaurus lived millions of years before Triceratops, so they never met!

26.label: Quetzalcoatlus
26.fact: This flying reptile had wings as wide as a small airplane!

27.label: Pachycephalosaurus
27.say: PAK ee SEF ah lo SORE us
27.fact: It had a thick, bony dome on its head, like a built in helmet.

28.label: So Many Dinos
28.fact: Scientists have named more than 1,000 different kinds of dinosaurs.

29.label: Your Colors
29.fact: Nobody knows the true colors of most dinosaurs, so you get to choose!

30.label: Dino Herds
30.fact: Many plant eating dinosaurs lived together in big groups called herds.

31.label: Footprints
31.fact: Dinosaur footprints left in mud turned into stone. You can still see some today!

32.label: Baby T. rex
32.fact: A baby T. rex was small and may have been covered in soft, fluffy feathers.

33.label: Diplodocus
33.fact: Diplodocus had a super long tail, and it may have swished it like a whip.

34.label: Tummy Stones
34.fact: Some dinosaurs swallowed small stones to help mash up the food in their tummies.

35.label: Everywhere
35.fact: Dinosaurs lived on every continent, even icy Antarctica!

36.label: No Flowers Yet
36.fact: When the first dinosaurs lived, there were no flowers. Flowers came much later!

37.label: Big Feet
37.fact: Some dinosaur footprints are bigger than a car tire!

38.label: No People
38.fact: Dinosaurs never met people. They lived millions of years before the first humans.

39.label: Still Here
39.fact: Birds are the dinosaurs that are still alive today!

40.label: Biggest Dinos
40.say: ar jen TEE no SORE us
40.fact: Argentinosaurus was one of the biggest dinosaurs ever, almost as long as three school buses!
